 Coby White (calf) officially out for Wednesday 
 by Leo Sells | Hornets Correspondent | Tue, Oct 20th 2026, 8:17pm EDT 
 Coby White (calf) is officially out for Wednesday's game against the Brooklyn Nets. ( NBA Injury Report ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 As expected, White is going to be sidelined on Wednesday. He's dealing with a calf injury right now, and the team has yet to determine an official timetable for his recovery. Grayson Allen and Dennis Schroder will both benefit from his absence for the time being.
